issues.description: The DV submodule is advanced to a newer Verus toolchain without regenerating the root `Cargo.lock`, leaving the committed dependency versions inconsistent with the toolchain used by verification.
issues.rationale: The reviewed revision changes only the DV gitlink, whose upgrade path pulls/builds a newer Verus checkout and synchronizes the workspace toolchain. It leaves the root lockfile pinned to the prior 2026-08-02 Verus package set. The first Ubuntu workflow verifies successfully but then fails its clean-worktree check after the build/format pipeline refreshes generated dependency state. The reviewer explicitly requests running `make verus-upgrade` and updating `Cargo.lock`; the author force-pushes a replacement head whose only additional root change updates `verus_builtin`, `verus_builtin_macros`, `verus_prettyplease`, and `vstd` to the 2026-08-09 versions, after which all checks pass. The failure condition is a non-reproducible committed workspace: a clean checkout mutates tracked dependency resolution during the required verification workflow.
issues.verification: source plus official historical CI metadata; historical Verus not executed locally. Recovered head a6a2b2d from GitHub Actions run 31366696780, fetched the exact object from the PR fork, verified its merge-base and one-file DV-only diff, confirmed the workflow passed verification but failed `Check for formatting changes`, and compared the force-pushed final head, which adds exactly the requested Cargo.lock version refresh and passes all checks. Historical job logs have expired with GitHub HTTP 410, so the step-level Actions metadata is the retained CI evidence.
